'''Kodi Vilthar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Yustavan Dreezian]] hired Vilthar to [[Death/Legends|murder]] the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] magnate [[Cilyn Gara]] and Vilthar successfully carried out the assignment, by destroying a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that Gara was traveling aboard. Vilthar later made his way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], where he planned to meet with Dreezian. However, Vilthar was sighted and word of his presence on Chandrila reach Gara's daughter, [[Magda Gara]], who hired a group of agents to capture Vilthar and take him to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], so that the assassin could face justice for causing her father's death. In addition, Dreezian secretly planned to eliminate Vilthar, to prevent anyone from linking Cilyn Gara's death to Dreezian.<ref name="CCW" />
